name: Fake Game (SavePoint test)
notes: Disposable test fixture - run `npm run fakegame:setup` to create the install and save directories this expects. No --save-dir arg on purpose: launch args are passed to the exe verbatim without {token} expansion, so the exe's own default save location is what keeps it aligned with external.path. To test the launcher-stub exit-detection path instead, change exePath to FakeGameLauncher.exe and leave processNameForExitDetection alone.
